description: Lens main window: core IPC for the read-only index commands (list_page, search, get_entry, facets, reveal_in_finder, copy_path) + reindex (spawns the canonical repo_index indexer to refresh INDEX.sqlite, then reopens it read-only) + the multi-project commands (list/list_status/current/add/switch/remove/index_project) + the Python-interpreter commands (python_status/set_python_path, which run a candidate interpreter to verify it) + the repoindex:// preview scheme. Plugins: tauri-plugin-dialog (dialog:default → folder picker for 'Add folder…') and tauri-plugin-drag (drag:default → native file drag-out of a row onto Finder/other apps). core:path:default lets the frontend resolveResource() the bundled fallback drag icon (the bundle also ships the Python crawler at $RESOURCE/repo_index, which only Rust resolves). No Tauri sidecar.
